WITH delivered_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    c.customer_unique_id,
    o.order_id,
    o.order_purchase_timestamp,
    SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS order_total
  FROM customers c
  JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id, o.order_id, o.order_purchase_timestamp
),
rfm_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_unique_id,
    COUNT(order_id) AS frequency,
    SUM(order_total) AS monetary,
    MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) AS last_purchase_date
  FROM delivered_orders
  GROUP BY customer_unique_id
),
rfm_scores AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_unique_id,
    frequency,
    monetary,
    last_purchase_date,
    (julianday('now') - julianday(last_purchase_date)) AS recency_days,
    CASE 
      WHEN (julianday('now') - julianday(last_purchase_date)) <= 30 THEN 1
      WHEN (julianday('now') - julianday(last_purchase_date)) <= 60 THEN 2
      WHEN (julianday('now') - julianday(last_purchase_date)) <= 90 THEN 3
      WHEN (julianday('now') - julianday(last_purchase_date)) <= 180 THEN 4
      ELSE 5
    END AS recency_score,
    CASE 
      WHEN frequency <= 1 THEN 5
      WHEN frequency <= 2 THEN 4
      WHEN frequency <= 4 THEN 3
      WHEN frequency <= 7 THEN 2
      ELSE 1
    END AS frequency_score,
    CASE 
      WHEN monetary <= 100 THEN 5
      WHEN monetary <= 200 THEN 4
      WHEN monetary <= 500 THEN 3
      WHEN monetary <= 1000 THEN 2
      ELSE 1
    END AS monetary_score
  FROM rfm_calc
)
SELECT 
  recency_score,
  frequency_score,
  monetary_score,
  AVG(order_total) AS avg_sales_per_order
FROM delivered_orders do
JOIN rfm_scores rs ON do.customer_unique_id = rs.customer_unique_id
GROUP BY recency_score, frequency_score, monetary_score
ORDER BY recency_score, frequency_score, monetary_score;

FROM batting b
JOIN player p ON b.player_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY b.g DESC, b.r DESC, b.h DESC, b.hr DESC
LIMIT 1
sql_drafts.reason: 사용자는 게임 수, 런, 히트, 홈런 중 최고값을 달성한 선수의 주 이름과 해당 점수를 요청했습니다. batting 테이블에는 g(게임 수), r(런), h(히트), hr(홈런) 컬럼이 있고, player 테이블에는 name_given(주 이름)이 있습니다. player_id로 조인하여 최고값을 가진 선수를 찾습니다. ORDER BY로 모든 지표를 내림차순 정렬하여 최고값을 우선적으로 추출합니다.

sql_drafts.query:
SELECT p.name_given, b.g AS games_played, b.r AS runs, b.h AS hits, b.hr AS home_runs
FROM batting b
JOIN player p ON b.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE b.g = (SELECT MAX(g) FROM batting)
   OR b.r = (SELECT MAX(r) FROM batting)
   OR b.h = (SELECT MAX(h) FROM batting)
   OR b.hr = (SELECT MAX(hr) FROM batting)
ORDER BY b.g DESC, b.r DESC, b.h DESC, b.hr DESC
sql_drafts.reason: 사용자는 경기 수, 득점, 안타, 홈런 중 각각 최고값을 기록한 선수의 이름(name_given)과 해당 점수값을 요청했습니다. batting 테이블에 g, r, h, hr 컬럼이 있고, player 테이블에 name_given이 있으므로 두 테이블을 player_id로 조인합니다. 각 지표의 최대값을 서브쿼리로 비교하여 OR 조건으로 해당 선수를 추출합니다. 결과는 각 지표별 최고값을 포함하며, 점수 내림차순으로 정렬해 명확히 표시합니다.
